courses.title: COMP 3522: Object Oriented Programming in C++
courses.description: Week 1: program structure, fundamental types, operators, casting, constants, console IO. Built from Jeff Yim's Week 1 slides and sample code.

courses.title: MATH 3042: Applied Probability and Statistics
courses.description: Unit 1: descriptive statistics — proportions, centre, variation, Z-scores, empirical rule, Chebyshev, quartiles, boxplots, outliers, skewness, correlation. Built from Carl Gladish's Unit 1 notes and Lab 1.

courses.title: COMP 3721: Introduction to Data Communications
courses.description: Weeks 1–2: data communications, networks and topologies, the Internet, protocol layering and TCP/IP, connecting devices, math review, analog and digital signals (sine waves, phase, wavelength, composite signals, bandwidth, bit rate). Built from Marco Ho's lectures 01a/01b/01c/02, the Math Review, E01/E02 and the sample quiz.
